sections.executive_summary: The quant stack is not yet producing actionable archived evidence: backtest, offline simulation, and historical analysis each have run_count=1 (history_run_count=0), so forward-return and strategy comparisons are still seeding. Forward paper learning is active but the primary ai_judgment track is verdict=underperforming: it beats the rules control on excess after costs (-3.82% vs -12.99%) yet still trails the market benchmark (beat_market=false, beat_control=true). Rules turnover is driving severe cost drag (10.7%) and deeper underperformance. The single biggest modelling/analysis gap this week is the absence of a second archived run — without run_count≥2, backtest horizons, offline sim excess returns, and historical overlay comparisons cannot be computed, leaving sprint decisions reliant on thin forward paper marks only.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- Primary (ai_judgment) excess after costs: -3.82% vs benchmark return +0.91%; total return -2.91%; beat_market=false.
- Control (rules) excess after costs: -12.99% vs benchmark return +2.01%; total return -10.98%; materially worse than primary.
- Primary vs control spread: +9.17 pp excess-after-costs advantage to ai_judgment (primary_excess_after_costs -0.0382 vs control -0.1299).
- Cost drag: ai_judgment 2.91% (29.15 on 1000 contributed, 5 trades); rules 10.71% (107.1 on 1000 contributed, 23 trades) — rules turnover is the dominant drag.
- Mark thickness: ai_judgment has 4 equity_marks and 5 trades (enough_history=true); rules has 5 equity_marks and 23 trades (enough_history=true); momentum_grace has 1 equity_mark, 0 trades, cash_fraction=1.0 (enough_history=false) — primary/control marks are minimally reviewable; momentum_grace is not trustable for performance conclusions.
- Decision review already applied clamped knob updates on ai_judgment (max_positions 5→4) and rules (max_positions 4→3, min_conviction 0.05→0.1); this report does not recommend further auto-application of decision-review knobs.

sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [monitoring] Archive-run gate dashboard — confirm second weekly archive lands and backtest/sim/historical_analysis run_count reaches 2 so top_horizons and excess_return series populate; expected learning value: unlocks first trustworthy archived vs forward evidence split.
2. [offline_sim] Counterfactual rules churn cap — replay rules track with max trades/month or min holding period vs observed 23-trade path; expected learning value: quantifies how much of -12.99% excess is turnover vs selection.
3. [paper_knobs] Post-apply ai_judgment max_positions=4 holdout — human-gated paper run with frozen knobs for 2+ review cycles; expected learning value: separates decision-review knob effect from prior 5-position book drift.
4. [paper_knobs] Momentum_grace seeding protocol — human-gated minimum entry schedule to reach ≥4 equity_marks and ≥2 trades; expected learning value: enables first benchmark-linked excess read on grace overlay vs ai_judgment control.
5. [attribution] Exit-shadow cohort bootstrap — tag first closed exits across rules and ai_judgment for grace_vs_rotation post-exit scoring; expected learning value: early signal on whether screen_rotation exits destroy value before any grace knob promotion.
